Vetting desk charges — for accounts

to
VesselIMOOwnerDivCoverage TypeInspectedCompleted VDSK (USD) RightShip (USD) Variance Total (USD) Invoice No.Status
Nothing to billNo completed inspections match this selection.
A charge is raised for each completed contracted and one-off inspection — the invoice amount is fixed when the result is entered on the Inspections tab. Not-contracted and unassigned inspections are never billed. Select the month, review the list, then Email to accounts or export, and Mark selected closed to record it as sent. Enter the Invoice No. against each row once accounts confirm it. Export/email gives accounts their columns: Sr. No., Vessel Name, Vessel Code, IMO, Type, Date, Country, Port and Invoice Amount.
Reconciliation: VDSK is the desk's $1,750 charge; RightShip is their own invoice for the same inspection; Variance is the desk charge as a % of RightShip's; Total is the two combined. The July figures are pre-filled, matched by IMO. Blank RightShip cells are inspections RightShip has not yet invoiced.
